## Clinical Summary & Explanation
The AI-powered multimodal diagnostic system analyzed the 48-year-old female patient's chest X-ray and clinical history. The model strongly diagnosed the patient with **Lung_Opacity** at a **100% confidence level**. The decision was almost entirely driven by visual opacities detected in the chest radiograph, as reflected by the high image importance weight. Clinicians should review the saved Grad-CAM heatmap (`outputs\gradcam_result.png`) to verify the specific pulmonary opacities highlighted by the model against the primary radiograph.
